cases.condition: The release, commit, or official documentation does not exactly match GPUMD v5.3.
cases.minimum_next_action: Pin the exact v5.3 tag, commit, banner, and bundled primary documentation.

cases.condition: A compute_phonon result is traced to GPUMD 5.1 or 5.2.
cases.minimum_next_action: Exclude the affected result and regenerate it only under a separately verified corrected version.

cases.condition: Fixed units, pbc, Lattice, or Properties mappings are missing or inconsistent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Align the exact GPUMD unit map and all three extxyz boundary and cell declarations.

cases.condition: Potential identity, hash, source, element map, compatibility, or independent license status is unresolved.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the exact potential bytes, element map, source, compatibility evidence, and independent terms.

cases.condition: A non-NEP periodic cell thickness is not greater than twice the potential cutoff.
cases.minimum_next_action: Enlarge the periodic cell or adopt a separately justified compatible interaction model.

cases.condition: New velocities rely on an omitted or conflicting seed, or a continuation does not preserve the declared state velocities.
cases.minimum_next_action: Choose one explicit initial-state route and bind the exact seed or state-file lineage.

cases.condition: Ensemble, dump_thermo, dump_restart, or dump_xyz is not repeated before each run block.
cases.minimum_next_action: Repeat every non-propagating control with the planned values before each run block.

cases.condition: A restart.xyz file is presented as exact integrator or thermostat and barostat continuation.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the state file and limit continuation claims to version-matched documented recoverability.

cases.condition: Stdout completion markers are missing or duplicated, or thermo rows are malformed, non-finite, or count-mismatched.
cases.minimum_next_action: Provide one exact clean output segment and diagnose the first completion or thermo mismatch.

cases.condition: Effective sample count or block-mean uncertainty misses a predeclared bound.
cases.minimum_next_action: Extend or replicate the unchanged predeclared production protocol and re-evaluate the same estimator.

cases.condition: Trajectory Time, pbc, Lattice, Properties, site order, cadence, or raw upstream lineage is inconsistent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Restore one exact raw-byte-bound trajectory segment with stable site order and documented cadence.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established from exact evidence, or execution, installation, scheduling, or resource control is requested.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop fail closed and obtain separately authenticated evidence and exact-scope execution authorization.
